newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Hoechst, units ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Hoechst, units ratings.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it had affirmed its A1 commercial paper ratings of Hoechst AG and related entities.
At the same time, S&P said it affirmed its A plus long-term ratings of Hoechst's related entities (see list below).
S&P said in a statement, the outlook on the ratings was stable.

"Against the background of a rapidly consolidating pharmaceuticals industry, structural changes in the chemical industry, and following top management change, there appears to be a willingness in the group to more aggressively address strategic options such as acquisitions and divestments," S&P said.

"These can have positive or negative rating implications. However...(the group) should benefit from a better earnings quality going forward given the shift away from more cyclical chemicals businesses towards pharmaceuticals, which has more stable and reliable cash flow characteristics."

S&P said the ratings affirmations followed Hoechst's announcements to combine its specialty chemicals activities with Clariant AG, and to offer to buy the 43 percent minority stake in its French pharmaceuticals subsidiary Roussel Uclaf which it does not already own.
